message.content: Based on the provided data, there is no direct message from Li Hua to Wolfgang Schulz indicating that he has prepared all the delicious food for tonight's Chinese Lunar New Year. Instead, Wolfgang Schulz sends a message wishing Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year and mentions looking forward to enjoying some good food together. Li Hua responds by expressing excitement about visiting a local festival to soak up the atmosphere and taking some photos, but does not mention preparing food specifically for the celebration. Therefore, it appears that Wolfgang Schulz did not receive a message from Li Hua about the food preparations before he wished him a happy Lunar New Year.
